prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Southeast US (Florida, Georgia, Texas)?
response_text:
In the Southeast—particularly across Florida, Georgia, and Texas—pest pressures are unique due to high humidity, year-round heat, and intense termite activity (especially subterranean and Formosan termites). 

The most reputable residential pest control companies operating in this region fall into two categories: **deeply rooted regional leaders** (which often earn higher customer satisfaction marks) and **national powerhouses** (which offer broad coverage and standardized warranties).
